decision.observation:
The top-left improvement icon shows tooltip 'Build Improvement: Camp (+1 Gold, Provides 0.5 Housing)'. But it only shows tooltip—no build started (the Builder still at 2/2, 3 builds). The icons are for a Camp which requires a resource tile - probably invalid on city center. The Builder is at Tenochtitlan city center. This is why nothing works: no valid improvement on the city center tile.

The ONLY fix is moving the Builder off the city center. My single tile-clicks deselect. In Civ VI you can move a unit by clicking a hex only for the first move sometimes, but with a Builder it should work with a plain click on an adjacent tile. Let me click directly on an adjacent workable tile (e.g., the grass to the south of the city, ~0.50,0.50) WHILE the Builder is selected. Single-click on empty tile should issue a move.
decision.hypothesis: Single left-click on adjacent empty grass tile moves the Builder there, clearing its order.
decision.memory: Builder on city center can't improve. Move off via single tile click.
